what: Real rhwp WASM renderer in a browser. Fixtures generated in-page (quadrant PNG/SVG/GIF, junk bytes); each scenario inserts one picture into HwpDocument.createEmpty() and renders page 0 with waits between renders. 'present' = which of the 4 quadrant colours are visible (tl,tr,bl,br); hash = FNV of all page pixels.
note: First render of a browser-decoded image is blank in all builds (asynchronous decode, unchanged pinned behaviour); the corrected build calls the load listener when it becomes drawable. 'orig' wasm was built from the identical patch text before this round (source diff re-verified identical).
